name: promotion-readiness-v2
hypothesis: A short observe-diagnose-act-verify loop makes balanced growth, sustainable capacity and obligation closure easier for the actor to execute than paragraph-only guidance.
change: Express the research strategy as a decision loop with an explicit expected benefit, realised-benefit check and compact commitment ledger. Preserve the frozen v1 comparison unchanged.
predicted_behaviour: The actor names a current gap, selects a feasible action to address it, verifies the actual change and redirects stalled investments while maintaining health, dignity and trust.
refutation: In a separately frozen same-actor comparison, no improvement in adherence or promotion with survival, or lower survival, leaves the improvement hypothesis unsupported. No results for this revision are claimed.
notes: Untested operational manual, not a promotion guarantee. Contains no research lookup, event mappings, numerical hidden thresholds or calendar triggers. Not automatically entered in the central race.
